headline: Lock the product
deliverables: Supplier details sheet (name, MOQ, cost, backup)
mentorQuestion: Is your product locked with real evidence someone will buy it? Do you have a genuine backup supplier, not just a primary?

headline: Pitch the IC
deliverables: Physical prototype ready to show IC

gate.name: Gate 1
gate.rule: Pass pitch → ₹30K released. Fail pitch → 1 re-attempt in 48 hrs.

mentorQuestion: Is your pitch deck IC-ready? Does it show a real path to ₹7L, not just a good story?

headline: Go live
deliverables: Live online store (product pages, checkout, payment gateway)
Social media accounts live (Instagram, LinkedIn, etc.)
mentorQuestion: Is your store actually live and taking payments? Is your 4-week content calendar submitted?

headline: First 10 customers
escalation: Lagging teams: mandatory review with BYOB Lead.
mentorQuestion: Which channels actually got you to ₹75K? Who are your first 10 customers, by name?

headline: Find what works
deliverables: Channel report: performance data per channel
Action plan to scale top channel

gate.name: Gate 3
gate.rule: M5 verified → next capital tranche released.

mentorQuestion: Which channel is genuinely profitable? What does your cost tracker say about margin?

headline: Scale the winner
deliverables: Mid-challenge reflection reel posted (top 3 wins + 3 challenges)
mentorQuestion: Is your reflection honest about what's not working — not just a highlight reel?

headline: Push hard

gate.name: Gate 4
gate.rule: M7 verified → final tranche (if applicable) unlocked. Released only if required.

mentorQuestion: Has your influencer collaboration actually gone live? What's genuinely automated now, not just planned?

dateConfirming.note: The milestones graphic dates M8 to 31 October, but the Challenge is confirmed to end on 30 October. The Flea Market date is being confirmed with the program team.

headline: Prove it, live
deliverables: Final blog published (~1,000 words: what worked, what didn't, lessons)

gate.name: Capital repayment
gate.rule: ₹1L repaid by 15 Nov. Capital default → grade penalty.

mentorQuestion: Is your team fully flea ready — inventory, payments, plan? Is your capital repayment on track?
